# Publications & Communications

> Source: https://www.cpaireland.ie
> Site: CPA Ireland
> Scraped: 2026-04-16

> Publications & Communications

#### •   Will I continue to receive a monthly member e-Bulletin?

No, the final Member e-Bulletin will be issued to members at the end of August.

#### •   Will the Accountancy Plus journal still be published?

No. The August 2024 edition will be the final edition of Accountancy Plus. It will not be published after that edition.

#### •   Can I still access past issues of Accountancy Plus?

Yes, you will still be able to access previous editions on Accountancy Plus through the CPA Ireland website.

#### •   Will I still receive Practice Plus?

No, the final Practice Plus was issued to members in August.

#### •   What publications will I receive from Chartered Accountants Ireland?

Chartered Accountants Ireland publish the Accountancy Ireland journal six times per year. You can find previous issues here.

There is also a bi-monthly publication for practitioners called Practice Matters. Past issues can be found here.

#### •   What other newsletters will I receive from Chartered Accountants Ireland?

Members of CPA Ireland will be automatically signed up to the following email newsletters:

- "Briefly" newsletter (every Monday)
- CPD weekly newsletter (every Wednesday)
- Weekly eNews bulletin (every Friday)
- Member Benefits newsletter
- Your local District Society news

#### •   Will I receive a diary in 2025?

Yes, CPA members who received a 2024 diary will receive a Chartered Accountants Ireland diary for 2025.

#### •   How do I ensure that I am on the Chartered Accountants Ireland mailing list?

You will be automatically added to the equivalent mailing lists in Chartered Accountants Ireland
